digest.en: US and Iran are closing in on a one-page memo to end the war. The development comes as the Middle East conflict tests ASEAN unity at a summit in Cebu, Philippines. US petrol prices have risen 50 percent since the war began.
digest.hi: अमेरिकी सैन्य अड्डे यूरोप में बढ़ रहे हैं। उनकी भूमिका और विस्तार के कारण चर्चा में हैं। अमेरिकी विदेश मंत्री ने ईरान के फैसलों से वैश्विक अर्थव्यवस्था पर खतरे की चेतावनी दी है।

articles.title: US-Israel-Iran War News Live Updates: US and Iran closing in on one-page memo to end war
articles.summary: The US said Operation Epic Fury concluded after Iran violated a ceasefire. US-Israel-Iran War News Live Updates: Day after ceasefire violation by Iran, US says Operation Epic Fury concluded The Times of India.

articles.title: Middle East conflict set to test ASEAN unity as leaders gather in Cebu for summit
articles.summary: ASEAN leaders gather in Cebu to discuss energy supply chains amid Middle East tensions. Tensions involving Iran and the Strait of Hormuz have disrupted energy supply chains, raising fresh risks for Southeast Asia.

articles.title: Marco Rubio confirms end of ‘Operation Epic Fury’ as US moves to reopen Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary: Marco Rubio confirmed the end of Operation Epic Fury as the US moves to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Marco Rubio confirms end of ‘Operation Epic Fury’ as US moves to reopen Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: PM Wong to attend ASEAN Summit in Cebu
articles.summary: PM Wong will attend the ASEAN Summit in Cebu to discuss green energy transition and supply chain disruptions. Among other matters, the ASEAN leaders will discuss how to accelerate the region's green energy transition in the midst of supply chain disruptions and rising energy prices from the situation in the Middle East.

articles.title: US petrol prices 50 percent higher than before war on Iran
articles.summary: US petrol prices are 50 percent higher than before the war on Iran at $4.48 per gallon. The average price of petrol in the United States has reached $4.48 per gallon, according to AAA.

articles.title: Vietnam President To Lam accorded ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his maiden visit to
articles.summary: Vietnam President To Lam received a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan on his maiden visit to India. The timing of President To Lam’s trip is particularly significant as it marks the “10th anniversary of the comprehensive strategic partnership” between India and Vietnam.

articles.title: U.S. stages largest-ever annual military drills in the Philippines
articles.summary: The US and its allies have conducted their largest-ever military drills in the Philippines, near Taiwan, showcasing new tactics and alliances to deter China. The exercises come as Beijing stages its own nearby drills.

articles.title: Iran says it wants a 'comprehensive agreement' with U.S.
articles.summary: Iran has expressed interest in a "comprehensive agreement" with the US. The Strait of Hormuz has been virtually shut since February 28, blocking about 20% of world oil supplies. The strait has ‌been virtually shut since the conflict began on February 28 with air attacks on Iran ‌by ⁠the U. S.

articles.title: US-Germany rift widens as Iran war drags on
articles.summary: A German official says the US-Europe relationship is being tested due to the Iran war. An opposition MP claims Berlin is "not neutral" in the conflict. German official says US-Europe relationship is being tested as opposition MP says Berlin is 'not neutral'.

articles.title: Four killed in post-poll unrest in India's West Bengal
articles.summary: Four people were killed in post-poll unrest in India's West Bengal. The incident occurred after recent elections in the region. Four killed in post-poll unrest in India's West Bengal.

articles.title: Kyiv reports fresh Russian attacks despite unilateral ceasefire
articles.summary: Ukraine's Kyiv reported fresh Russian attacks despite a unilateral ceasefire. The attacks occurred amidst ongoing conflict between Ukraine and Russia. Ukraine war latest: Kyiv reports fresh Russian attacks despite unilateral ceasefire The Independent.

articles.title: Australian women with alleged ISIL ties returning from Syria, minister says
articles.summary: Australian Federal Police Commissioner Krissy Barrett says women with alleged ISIL ties are returning from Syria, with some to be arrested and charged. The individuals will face prosecution for their alleged involvement with the terrorist group.

articles.title: FedEx driver who delivered ‘Barbie’ dolls sentenced to death for killing 7-year-old recipient in
articles.summary: A FedEx driver in the US was sentenced to death for killing a 7-year-old recipient who opened a package containing 'Barbie' dolls. The driver had delivered the package, which contained a lethal substance, to the child's home.

articles.title: COE prices up across the board, Category A nears S$125,000
articles.summary: Category A COE premiums in Singapore rose to S$124,790 in the latest bidding exercise, marking the sixth consecutive increase. The surge in prices has affected all categories of COE. Category A premiums rose for the sixth straight COE bidding exercise, closing at S$124,790.

articles.title: Gasoline Costs 50% More In The US Than It Did Before Iran War
articles.summary: Gasoline prices in the US have increased by 50% since the Iran war, due to reduced oil supplies on the market. Higher oil prices have led to higher gasoline costs for consumers.

articles.title: Inside Cruise Ship At The Center Of A Deadly Hantavirus Outbreak
articles.summary: The World Health Organization is investigating a hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship, suspecting initial infection occurred before passengers boarded. Possible human transmission is also being examined by WHO officials.

articles.title: Syria says it dismantled Hezbollah-linked cell plotting assassinations
articles.summary: Syrian authorities dismantled a cell linked to Hezbollah, allegedly planning targeted assassinations against high-level government officials. The cell's members and exact plans were not disclosed. Authorities say the cell was planning 'targeted assassinations against high-level government officials'.

articles.title: Cruise Ship Hantavirus Outbreak: Rare Human-To-Human Transmission Suspected, Says WHO
articles.summary: A hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius cruise ship has resulted in three deaths. The World Health Organization suspects rare human-to-human transmission. The hantavirus outbreak on MV Hondius has left 3 dead so far.

articles.title: Trump-backed Vivek Ramaswamy wins Republican nomination for Ohio Governor
articles.summary: Vivek Ramaswamy, who previously ran against Trump for the Republican presidential nomination, won the Republican nomination for Ohio Governor with Trump's backing. Ramaswamy had withdrawn from the presidential race and endorsed Trump.

articles.title: U.S.-Iran ceasefire holding for now, Hegseth says, as Trump looks to finalize deal
articles.summary: A US-Iran ceasefire is currently holding, according to Hegseth, as Trump looks to finalize a deal. The ceasefire has been in place for several days, but its long-term prospects remain uncertain.

articles.title: Trump talks about progress in talks; Rubio says war ‘over’
articles.summary: US President Trump paused the 'Project Freedom' operation in the Strait of Hormuz, citing progress towards an Iran agreement. Senator Rubio stated the war is 'over', following Trump's announcement. Trump pauses US 'Project Freedom' operation in Strait of Hormuz, citing progress towards Iran agreement.
